name: PR Babysitter
description: Watch labeled PRs: triage, fix CI once, rebase, escalate stale.
kickoff:
Start the "PR Babysitter" loop.
Goal: watched PRs healthy or escalated
Max iterations: 20
Between iterations run: gh pr list --label codex-watch
Exit when: each watched PR green and current, or escalated.
Orientation: read the linked ticket for which PRs or labels to watch.
Step 1: List open PRs with the watch label and triage the first stale or failing one.

loop_contract.name: PR Babysitter
loop_contract.goal: open PRs labeled codex-watch are healthy (CI green, rebased, not stale)
loop_contract.exit_when: each watched PR is green and current, or escalated
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Run gh pr list with the watch label (or project equivalent). Note stale, failing, or behind-main PRs.

steps.name: List watched PRs
steps.instruction: Run gh pr list with the watch label (or project equivalent). Note stale, failing, or behind-main PRs.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites

steps.validation_prompt: Step 'List watched PRs' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Triage each PR
steps.instruction: For each watched PR: CI status, review state, behind-main. One action per PR this iteration.

steps.other_tool: gh pr view / gh pr checks

steps.name: Remediate once
steps.instruction: Fix CI once, rebase if behind, or comment if stale. Escalate repeated failures.
